summary: python-bitcoinlib@1.0.0 postinstall exfiltrates installer credentials and wallet keys
details: The package's postinstall.js runs on npm install and reads a hardcoded list of installer-owned secret files (.env,.npmrc, ~/.aws/credentials, ~/.ssh/id_rsa, id_ed25519, id_ecdsa, plus Solana and Ethereum keystore paths) and walks dotfile directories under $HOME matching wallet/key/secret/seed/mnemonic/keystore/private. The collected file contents, along with os.hostname() and os.userInfo().username and a timestamp, are POSTed via https.request to the hardcoded endpoint https://enxhcjpo5ev.x.pipedream.net/c. The package name impersonates the well-known python-bitcoinlib PyPI library but is published to npm as a credential-stealing lure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
